title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋~SPMT bridge replacement
focus: 以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋~Support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours
summary: 從整跨上部結構改由運輸車支承時的彎矩反轉出發，計算動態放大、軸線數量、臨時支撐塔穩定與行駛路徑地盤承載，再處理封閉時段時程、落梁行程與支承對位、移動中的應變與水平監測、地盤預壓試驗，最後檢核既有下部結構、評估用路人成本並交接，案例取自 FHWA 手冊中的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue、荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 與芝加哥 Wells Street 換橋。~Starting from the moment reversal when a whole span is carried by transporters, compute dynamic allowance, axle-line count, temporary-tower stability and travel-path bearing, then handle the closure timeline, set-down stroke and bearing alignment, strain and level monitoring during the move and ground proof testing, and finally check the existing substructure, evaluate user costs and hand over, with cases from the FHWA manual: Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue, the Netherlands' Badhoevedorp A4/A5 and Chicago's Wells Street replacements.

units.anchor: 運輸車支承點與懸臂端~SPMT support points and overhangs
units.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉~Support-point change and moment reversal during the move
units.mechanism: 以自行式模組運輸車（SPMT）換橋時，新橋整跨先在附近的預製區臨時支架上完成，再由運輸車從梁下頂起、開到橋位、降落到支承上；舊橋則以相反流程移走。運輸車的支承點通常位於梁端內側數公尺，而不是永久支承位置，所以運輸期間梁成為兩端外伸的簡支梁：跨中正彎矩略減，但梁端出現營運時不存在的負彎矩。預力梁端部頂緣在營運時本來就受預力拉應力，再加上外伸負彎矩，可能開裂，因此支承點位置必須由設計者決定，而不是由運輸商依車輛配置自行選擇。~In an SPMT replacement, the new span is completed on temporary supports in a nearby staging area, lifted from below by self-propelled modular transporters, driven to site and lowered onto its bearings, while the old span is removed by the reverse process. The transporter support points usually lie a few metres inside the girder ends rather than at the permanent bearings, so during transport the girder becomes a simple beam with overhangs: midspan sagging moment drops slightly, but the ends see hogging moment that never occurs in service. At prestressed girder ends the top fibre already carries tension from prestress, and the overhang moment can crack it, so support positions must be set by the designer, not chosen by the transport contractor to suit the vehicle layout.
units.model: 跨長 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m），運輸支點內縮 a = 3.0 m：支點間 34 m，跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m（營運簡支為 wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m）；梁端負彎矩 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m，乘以 15% 動態放大為 1,294 kN·m。數值為教學假設。~For a 40 m span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) carried at points a = 3.0 m inside the ends, the supports are 34 m apart and midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m versus wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m simply supported in service; the end hogging moment is 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m, or 1,294 kN·m with a 15% dynamic allowance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計者以運輸支點位置、預力與自重建立運輸狀態模型，檢核梁端頂緣與跨中底緣在包含動態放大後的應力，並與規範施工期容許值比較；運輸商提交的車輛配置圖必須標示每一支承點座標，由設計者比對確認。~The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point.
units.failure: 運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。~A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs.
units.misconception: 運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。~Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity.
units.practice: 合約圖說應明訂運輸與暫置期間的容許支承區域、最大外伸長度與動態放大假設，並要求承包商提送運輸階段計算，經設計單位審查同意後才可施作。~Contract drawings should define permitted support zones, maximum overhang and the dynamic allowance for transport and storage, and require the contractor to submit transport-stage calculations accepted by the designer before work.

units.anchor: 軸線容量與液壓分組~Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping
units.title: 軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承~Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support
units.mechanism: SPMT 由多個六軸或四軸模組拼接，每一軸線有額定承載，懸吊為液壓式：同一液壓群組內各軸壓力相等，因此可以把整組車輛分成三個液壓群組，形成靜定的三點支承。這樣地面起伏或坡度變化只讓橋體整體傾斜，不會強迫橋體扭曲；若誤設成四點以上的獨立群組，地面一處下陷就會讓某一角卸載、對角加載，在橋面產生扭轉。FHWA 手冊建議運輸時至少加上 15% 的自重動態放大，並且不允許暫時超應力。~SPMTs are assembled from six- or four-axle modules, each axle line with a rated capacity, and their suspension is hydraulic: pressures are equal within a hydraulic group, so the fleet can be divided into three groups to form a statically determinate three-point support. Ground undulations or grade changes then merely tilt the span as a whole without forcing it to twist; set up wrongly as four or more independent groups, a dip under one corner unloads it and overloads the diagonal, twisting the deck. The FHWA manual recommends a dynamic allowance of at least 15% on dead load during the move and allows no temporary overstress.
units.model: 橋體 10,000 kN 加臨時支撐 1,000 kN，乘 1.15 動態放大為 12,650 kN。FHWA 手冊所列每軸線約 24 至 30 t，取保守 24 t ≈ 235 kN：需 12,650/235 ≈ 54 軸線；若利用率限 80%，需 54/0.8 ≈ 68 軸線，可用 12 組六軸模組共 72 軸線。數值為教學假設。~A 10,000 kN span plus 1,000 kN of temporary supports, times 1.15 dynamic allowance, gives 12,650 kN. Taking the conservative end of the FHWA range of about 24 to 30 t per axle line, 24 t ≈ 235 kN, needs 12,650/235 ≈ 54 axle lines; limiting utilisation to 80% needs 54/0.8 ≈ 68, provided by 12 six-axle modules with 72 axle lines. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 運輸商的配置計算須列出每一群組的軸線數、群組合力位置與橋體重心的關係、每軸線荷載與利用率；頂升時以各群組液壓讀值反算實際重量與重心，與計算值比較（例如差異超過 5% 即停止查明）。~The transporter's layout calculation must list axle lines per group, the relation between group resultants and the span's centre of gravity, and load and utilisation per axle line; at lift-off, back-calculate actual weight and centre of gravity from group pressures and compare with calculation, stopping to investigate if they differ by more than, for example, 5%.
units.failure: 橋體實際重量因額外鋪面、護欄或臨時材料超出估算，軸線利用率超過額定值，輪胎或懸吊在行駛中失效；液壓群組設定錯誤造成四點支承，經過路面坡度轉折時橋面扭轉開裂。~Extra surfacing, barriers or temporary materials push the real weight above the estimate, exceeding axle-line ratings so tyres or suspension fail en route; wrongly configured hydraulic groups create four-point support that twists and cracks the deck at a grade break.
units.misconception: SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。~More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference.
units.practice: 運輸前以實際稱重或液壓讀值確認橋體重量與重心，群組設定與利用率上限由運輸工程師簽認並經設計單位確認；任何臨時增加的材料都必須登記並重算。~Before the move, confirm span weight and centre of gravity by weighing or hydraulic readings; the group configuration and utilisation limit are signed by the transport engineer and confirmed by the designer, and any added material is logged and recalculated.

units.anchor: 運輸車上的臨時支撐塔~Temporary towers on the transporters
units.title: 臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓~Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing
units.mechanism: 橋梁支承面通常比運輸車平台高出數公尺，所以運輸車上要架設臨時支撐塔或疊木，把橋體頂到所需高度。這些支撐塔在行駛中承受加速、煞車、坡度與轉向造成的水平力，又坐在會微小起伏的液壓平台上，橫向穩定與塔頂和梁底的接觸都必須設計：接觸點應對準橫隔梁或腹板，並以墊板分散壓力；塔身需交叉斜撐，塔頂與梁體要有防滑與限位。~Bridge seats are usually several metres above the transporter decks, so temporary towers or cribbing on the transporters raise the span to the required height. During travel these towers take horizontal forces from acceleration, braking, grade and steering while standing on hydraulic platforms that move slightly, so their lateral stability and the contact between tower head and girder must be designed: contact points should align with diaphragms or webs with spreader plates, towers need cross-bracing, and the head needs anti-slip and restraint devices against the span.
units.model: 單塔垂直力 P = 2,750 kN、高 6 m，坡度 2% 加煞車 0.05g 的水平係數 0.07：H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN，塔底傾覆彎矩 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m；塔底寬 3 m 的抵抗彎矩 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m，安全係數 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6。數值為教學假設。~With a tower load P = 2,750 kN, height 6 m and a horizontal coefficient of 0.07 from a 2% grade plus 0.05g braking, H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN and the overturning moment at the base is 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m; a 3 m base gives a restoring moment of 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m, a factor of 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 臨時支撐塔須有設計計算與製作圖，組立後檢查斜撐、螺栓與焊縫，並量測塔頂高程與垂直度；橋體頂升初期以小量頂起暫停，檢查接觸點是否均勻受壓、墊板有無偏移，再繼續頂升。~Temporary towers need design calculations and shop drawings; after erection check bracing, bolts and welds and survey head levels and plumbness; at the start of lifting, raise a little and pause to confirm contact points bear evenly and spreader plates have not shifted before continuing.
units.failure: 支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。~Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off; contact points away from diaphragms crush the soffit flange or buckle a steel bottom flange locally, forcing the move to stop.
units.misconception: 臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。~Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible.
units.practice: 臨時支撐塔與梁體連接細部屬於停留點，須由專業技師設計簽認並在頂升前檢查；行駛速度、轉向半徑與緊急煞車程序寫入運輸計畫，並與支撐塔設計採用的水平係數一致。~Temporary towers and their connection to the span are a hold point, designed and signed by a qualified engineer and inspected before lifting; travel speed, turning radius and emergency braking procedures go into the transport plan consistent with the horizontal coefficient used for the towers.

units.anchor: 行駛路徑地盤承載~Travel-path ground bearing
units.title: 行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線~Travel path, ground bearing and buried services
units.mechanism: SPMT 把數千噸的力量分散在大量輪胎上，每一軸線的接地壓力不高，但整個車隊下方的地盤承受大面積、長時間的荷載，地面的沉陷差會讓橋體傾斜，局部軟弱點甚至讓單一軸線陷落。FHWA 手冊指出每一軸線最大接地壓力約為每平方英尺 1,500 至 2,000 磅，車輛可吸收約 18 吋的地面起伏、爬升約 8% 的坡度。行駛路徑下方的箱涵、管線與擋土牆必須逐一檢核，路面還要有足夠平整度與排水，避免雨水使路基軟化。~SPMTs spread thousands of tonnes over many tyres, so pressure under each axle line is modest, but the ground beneath the whole fleet carries a large area for a long time; differential settlement tilts the span and a local soft spot can sink a single axle line. The FHWA manual gives a maximum ground pressure per axle line of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot, with surface variations of about 18 inches and grades of about 8% manageable by the vehicles. Culverts, utilities and retaining walls under the travel path must each be checked, and the surface needs enough flatness and drainage so rain does not soften the subgrade.
units.model: 每軸線 235 kN、輪組占地 2.43 m × 1.5 m = 3.65 m²：接地壓力 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa（約 1,350 psf），在 FHWA 所列範圍下限附近。以 2:1 擴散至 1.5 m 深，單軸線下方應力約 235/[(2.43 + 1.5)×(1.5 + 1.5)] ≈ 20 kPa，但相鄰軸線重疊時應以整個車隊面積檢核。數值為教學假設。~For 235 kN per axle line on a 2.43 m × 1.5 m footprint of 3.65 m², ground pressure is 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa (about 1,350 psf), near the lower end of the FHWA range. Spreading 2:1 to 1.5 m depth gives about 235/[(2.43 + 1.5)×(1.5 + 1.5)] ≈ 20 kPa under a single line, but overlapping adjacent lines mean the check must use the whole fleet footprint. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以鑽探、平鈑載重試驗或動態圓錐貫入試驗確認行駛路徑承載，調查並標示所有地下管線與結構物；必要時以鋼板、級配層或臨時路面加強，並在路徑上設測點，預壓後量測沉陷。~Confirm bearing along the path by borings, plate-load tests or dynamic cone penetration, survey and mark all buried services and structures, strengthen with steel plates, granular layers or temporary paving where needed, and set survey points on the path to measure settlement after proof loading.
units.failure: 未調查的地下排水箱涵在車隊通過時壓垮，單側軸線下陷，橋體大幅傾斜；雨後路基軟化使車輛液壓行程用盡，橋體被迫停在路中央，延長封閉時間並造成橋體受扭。~An unrecorded drainage culvert collapses under the fleet and one side drops, tilting the span sharply; a subgrade softened by rain exhausts the hydraulic stroke and leaves the span stranded mid-route, extending the closure and twisting the span.
units.misconception: SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。~With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks.
units.practice: 行駛路徑設計須包括地盤調查、地下設施清單與保護措施、平整度與排水要求，並在運輸前一天做最後巡查；天候不佳時依事先訂定的條件延期，而不是冒險移動。~The travel-path design must include ground investigation, a buried-services register with protection measures, and flatness and drainage requirements, with a final walk-down the day before; in bad weather postpone by pre-agreed criteria instead of risking the move.

units.title: 預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制~Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting
units.mechanism: SPMT 換橋的價值在於把現場對交通的影響從數月縮短到數小時或一個週末：新橋在預製區與交通隔離的條件下施工，舊橋在封閉開始後被整跨移走，支承座與台帽在短時間內整修，新橋開到位、落梁，接著完成引道與接縫，最後恢復通車。FHWA 手冊的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue 案例中，每跨新橋從預製區運到橋位約 30 分鐘，但手冊也提醒，道路與引道工程必須跟上橋梁的速度，否則封閉時間會被非橋梁工項拖長。~The value of an SPMT replacement lies in shrinking the traffic impact from months to hours or a weekend: the new span is built in a staging area away from traffic, the old span is carried off whole once the closure starts, bearing seats and caps are refurbished quickly, the new span is driven in and set, approaches and joints are completed and traffic resumes. In the FHWA manual's Florida I-4/Graves Avenue case each new span took about 30 minutes to travel from the staging area to the bridge, but the manual also warns that roadwork must keep pace with the bridge or non-bridge items will stretch the closure.
units.model: 週末封閉 55 h 的時程預算：舊橋移除 2 h、支承座整修 8 h、新橋運入 1 h、落梁與對位 3 h、引道版與鋪面 20 h，合計 34 h，餘裕 55 − 34 = 21 h。若引道版改為現場澆置需 36 h，合計 50 h，餘裕只剩 5 h。數值為教學假設。~A 55 h weekend closure budget: old span removal 2 h, bearing-seat repair 8 h, moving in the new span 1 h, set-down and alignment 3 h, approach slabs and paving 20 h, totalling 34 h with 55 − 34 = 21 h of float. If approach slabs are cast in place taking 36 h, the total is 50 h and only 5 h of float remains. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以分鐘級時程表演練整個封閉時段，列出每一工項的前置條件、負責人與替代方案；封閉前一週召開準備會議確認設備、人員、材料與天候，封閉期間每小時比對實際進度與計畫，落後超過預設門檻即啟動應變方案。~Rehearse the whole closure with a minute-level schedule listing each activity's prerequisites, owner and fallback; hold a readiness meeting a week before to confirm equipment, crews, materials and weather, and during the closure compare progress with the plan hourly, triggering contingency plans if slippage exceeds a preset threshold.
units.failure: 橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。~The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move; finding severely deteriorated bearing seats only after removing the old span needs repair time far beyond the budget.
units.misconception: 只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。~If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours.
units.practice: 合約以封閉時段為核心訂定獎懲，要求承包商事先調查並預修支承座、預製引道版或採用早強材料，並準備備用設備；封閉開始的放行條件（設備、天候、人員）由業主與承包商共同簽認。~Contracts build incentives and penalties around the closure window, require the contractor to investigate and pre-repair bearing seats, prefabricate approach slabs or use rapid-strength materials and keep standby equipment; release to start the closure (equipment, weather, crews) is signed jointly by owner and contractor.

units.anchor: 落梁對位與支承墊~Set-down alignment and bearing pads
units.title: 液壓行程、落梁與支承對位~Hydraulic stroke, set-down and bearing alignment
units.mechanism: SPMT 以液壓懸吊升降，行程有限：FHWA 手冊指出可用垂直行程至少約 24 吋，作業時宜只假設 16 至 20 吋。這段行程要同時應付頂起時越過支承座的淨空、行駛中的地面起伏，以及落梁時支點由運輸點移到永久支承所造成的撓度改變。落梁時先粗對位，再以液壓微調平面與高程，最後慢慢下降使梁平均坐上支承；任何一個支承懸空或偏壓，都會讓梁體以三點支承並在活載下搖動。~SPMTs raise and lower through hydraulic suspension with limited stroke: the FHWA manual gives a minimum available vertical stroke of about 24 inches and advises assuming only 16 to 20 inches in operations. This stroke must cover the clearance over the bearing seats at lift-off, ground undulations on the route, and the change in deflection when support moves from the transport points to the permanent bearings at set-down. Set-down starts with rough alignment, then hydraulic fine adjustment in plan and level, and finally a slow descent so the girders seat evenly; any bearing left unloaded or overloaded leaves the span rocking on three supports under traffic.
units.model: EI = 1.2×10⁸ kN·m²、w = 250 kN/m：支點內縮 3 m 時跨中自重撓度 5wL'⁴/(384EI) − wa²L'²/(16EI) ≈ 34.9 mm，移到 40 m 支承後為 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 69.4 mm，增加約 34.5 mm。行程預算：越過支承淨空 50 mm + 撓度變化 35 mm + 支承座誤差 20 mm ≈ 105 mm，小於作業行程 16 吋（約 406 mm）。數值為教學假設。~With EI = 1.2×10⁸ kN·m² and w = 250 kN/m, self-weight midspan deflection with supports 3 m inside the ends is 5wL'⁴/(384EI) − wa²L'²/(16EI) ≈ 34.9 mm, rising to 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 69.4 mm on the 40 m bearings, an increase of about 34.5 mm. Stroke budget: 50 mm clearance over bearings + 35 mm deflection change + 20 mm seat tolerance ≈ 105 mm, below an operational stroke of 16 inches (about 406 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 封閉前量測並記錄每一支承座的高程與平面位置，與新橋實測的支承面位置比對，預先準備墊片；落梁後量測各支承的壓縮或荷重、梁端高程與橫坡，確認四個支承都已受力，再解除運輸車與臨時限位。~Before the closure, survey every bearing seat's level and position and compare with the measured bearing locations on the new span, preparing shims in advance; after set-down, measure bearing compression or load, girder-end levels and cross-fall, confirming all four bearings carry load before releasing the transporters and temporary restraints.
units.failure: 行程預算未計入撓度變化，運輸車降到底時梁端仍未坐上支承，只能加臨時墊塊；支承座高程誤差未事先處理，落梁後一角懸空，日後支承偏壓損壞並在伸縮縫處形成錯台。~A stroke budget that ignores the deflection change bottoms out the transporters before the girder ends reach the bearings, forcing temporary packing; unaddressed seat-level errors leave one corner unloaded after set-down, later damaging bearings by uneven pressure and stepping the expansion joint.
units.misconception: SPMT 的升降行程很大，落梁時不需要預先計算行程與撓度。~SPMT lift range is so large that set-down needs no stroke or deflection calculation.
units.practice: 落梁程序書須含行程預算、各支承座實測高程與墊片配置、對位允差與最終驗收量測；落梁與釋放運輸車列為停留點，由設計與監造代表在場確認。~The set-down procedure must contain the stroke budget, measured seat levels and shim layout, alignment tolerances and final acceptance measurements; set-down and release of the transporters are hold points witnessed by design and supervision representatives.

units.anchor: 移動中的應變與水平儀~Strain and tilt monitoring during the move
units.title: 運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件~Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move
units.mechanism: 運輸期間橋體處於非設計狀態，監測可把這段風險轉為可量測的數據：在運輸支點附近梁端頂緣與跨中底緣貼應變計，在橋面設傾斜儀或水準點監看縱橫向傾斜，並記錄每一液壓群組壓力與車速。運輸商的控制系統本身會保持平台水平，但只有在橋體上量測，才能知道橋體實際承受的應力與扭轉。每一項都要有預先設定的警戒值與停止值，並由專人負責通報。~During the move the span is in a non-design state, and monitoring turns that risk into measurable data: strain gauges on the top fibre near the transport supports and on the bottom fibre at midspan, tilt sensors or level points on the deck for longitudinal and transverse tilt, and logs of every hydraulic group's pressure and the travel speed. The transporter's control system keeps its platform level, but only measurements on the span show the stresses and twist it actually experiences. Every quantity needs pre-set alert and stop values and a person responsible for reporting.
units.model: 梁端負彎矩含動態放大 1,294 kN·m，由 4 根梁分擔每根約 324 kN·m；梁頂斷面模數 S = 0.35 m³ 時頂緣附加應力 324/0.35 ≈ 924 kPa ≈ 0.92 MPa，換算應變 0.92/33,000 ≈ 28 με，應變計解析度須優於約 5 με 才能分辨。數值為教學假設。~The end hogging moment with dynamic allowance, 1,294 kN·m, shared by 4 girders is about 324 kN·m each; with a top section modulus S = 0.35 m³ the added top-fibre stress is 324/0.35 ≈ 924 kPa ≈ 0.92 MPa, a strain of 0.92/33,000 ≈ 28 με, so gauges must resolve better than about 5 με. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 感測器在頂升前完成安裝與歸零，以靜態頂升（不行駛）先確認應變與計算值相符；行駛中以無線傳輸即時顯示，數據與時間、位置同步記錄；運輸後與計算比較並附於竣工報告。~Install and zero sensors before lift-off and confirm with a static lift, without travelling, that strains match calculation; during travel display data in real time by wireless with synchronised time and position; afterwards compare with calculation and attach to the completion report.
units.failure: 沒有橋體監測時，運輸車平台雖然保持水平，但臨時支撐塔沉陷或接觸點滑移使橋體扭轉，直到落梁後才在梁端發現裂縫；監測資料若未與位置同步，事後無法判斷問題發生在路徑哪一段。~Without monitoring on the span, the transporter platforms stay level but a settling tower or slipping contact twists the span, and cracks at the girder ends are found only after set-down; monitoring not synchronised with position cannot show afterwards where along the route the problem occurred.
units.misconception: 運輸車有自動調平系統，所以橋體在運輸中不會受到額外應力。~Because transporters self-level, the span sees no extra stress during the move.
units.practice: 監測計畫列出感測器位置、警戒與停止值、通報流程與責任人，運輸指揮聽到停止通報即停車；監測原始資料隨竣工文件保存，供未來評估。~The monitoring plan lists sensor locations, alert and stop values, the reporting chain and responsible people, and the move commander stops immediately on a stop call; raw monitoring data are kept with the completion documents for future assessment.

units.anchor: 平鈑載重試驗與試行~Plate-load test and trial run
units.title: 行駛路徑預壓試驗與試行~Proof testing and trial run of the travel path
units.mechanism: 地盤調查只能抽樣，真正的驗證是讓路徑在接近實際荷載下表現一次：先以平鈑載重試驗取得路基模數，估算車隊下的沉陷；再以配重或空車試行全路徑，量測沉陷、找出軟弱點並演練轉向、加減速與通訊。FHWA 手冊的荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 案例以 134 軸線移動逾 3,600 噸的兩跨橋，手冊特別指出成功依靠良好的地盤準備與平整路面。~Ground investigation only samples; the real proof is letting the path perform once under near-actual load: a plate-load test first gives the subgrade modulus for estimating settlement under the fleet, then a ballasted or empty trial run over the full route measures settlement, finds soft spots and rehearses steering, acceleration, braking and communications. In the FHWA manual's Badhoevedorp A4/A5 case in the Netherlands, 134 axle lines moved a two-span bridge of more than 3,600 tons, and the manual notes that success depended on good ground preparation and level surfaces.
units.model: 平鈑試驗 s = q·B·(1 − ν²)·I/E。q = 100 kPa、鈑徑 B = 0.6 m、ν = 0.3、I = 0.785，實測 s = 2.0 mm：E = 100×0.6×0.91×0.785/0.002 ≈ 21,400 kPa。車隊下 q = 64.6 kPa、寬 2.43 m：s ≈ 64.6×2.43×0.91×0.785/21,400 ≈ 5.2 mm；兩側相差 50% 時差異沉陷約 2.6 mm。數值為教學假設。~Plate-load test s = q·B·(1 − ν²)·I/E. With q = 100 kPa, plate B = 0.6 m, ν = 0.3, I = 0.785 and a measured s = 2.0 mm, E = 100×0.6×0.91×0.785/0.002 ≈ 21,400 kPa. Under the fleet, q = 64.6 kPa over a 2.43 m width gives s ≈ 64.6×2.43×0.91×0.785/21,400 ≈ 5.2 mm; a 50% difference between the two sides means about 2.6 mm differential settlement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 沿路徑每隔固定距離及所有可疑位置做平鈑試驗，結果繪成承載分布圖；試行時在路面測點量測前後高程，與估算沉陷比較，超過預設值的位置加強後重測；試行同時演練通訊、緊急停車與撤離。~Run plate-load tests at fixed intervals along the path and at every suspect location, plotting a bearing map; during the trial run survey road points before and after, compare with estimated settlement and strengthen and retest any location exceeding the preset value; rehearse communications, emergency stops and evacuation at the same time.
units.failure: 省略試行，正式運輸時在路徑轉彎處遇到未壓實的回填土，軸線下陷使橋體傾斜，被迫停車補強，封閉時段大幅延長；轉向演練不足則可能讓懸臂端碰撞路旁設施。~Skipping the trial run means meeting uncompacted backfill at a bend during the real move; axle lines sink, the span tilts and the fleet must stop for strengthening, greatly extending the closure; too little steering rehearsal can let an overhang strike roadside structures.
units.misconception: 地質報告合格就代表行駛路徑一定能承受運輸荷載。~A satisfactory geotechnical report guarantees the route can take the transport load.
units.practice: 預壓試驗與試行是正式運輸前的停留點，結果須經運輸工程師與設計單位確認；試行發現的問題與修正措施列入運輸計畫的最終版。~Proof testing and the trial run are hold points before the real move, with results confirmed by the transport engineer and designer; problems found and fixes made are written into the final transport plan.

units.anchor: 既有下部結構承載~Existing substructure capacity
units.title: 新舊介面與下部結構的耐久評估~Interfaces and durability of the existing substructure
units.mechanism: SPMT 換橋常保留既有橋台與橋墩，只更換上部結構，但新橋可能更長、更寬或更重：FHWA 手冊的 Graves Avenue 案例中，新跨約 143 ft、重約 1,300 噸，取代的舊中跨僅約 70.5 ft、約 250 噸。下部結構必須以新反力重新評估承載、耐震與耐久，包括混凝土劣化、鋼筋腐蝕、基礎沖刷與支承座強度。新舊混凝土的接縫、伸縮縫與排水細部也要重新設計，否則換了新橋，水仍沿舊縫滲入下部結構。~SPMT replacements often keep the existing abutments and piers and replace only the superstructure, but the new span may be longer, wider or heavier: in the FHWA manual's Graves Avenue case the new spans were about 143 ft long and about 1,300 tons, replacing an old middle span of about 70.5 ft and about 250 tons. The substructure must be re-assessed for the new reactions in capacity, seismic performance and durability, including concrete deterioration, reinforcement corrosion, foundation scour and seat strength. Joints between new and old concrete, expansion joints and drainage must also be redesigned, or water will keep seeping along old joints into the substructure under the new span.
units.model: 舊跨 4,000 kN 每端反力 2,000 kN，新跨 10,000 kN 每端 5,000 kN，增為 2.5 倍。若既有基樁每支容許 800 kN、原有 4 支共 3,200 kN，已不足 5,000 kN，需補樁或新建橋台。數值為教學假設。~An old 4,000 kN span gives 2,000 kN per end; a new 10,000 kN span gives 5,000 kN, 2.5 times as much. If the existing piles are rated 800 kN each and four give 3,200 kN, they cannot carry 5,000 kN, so added piles or a new abutment are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計前完成下部結構詳細檢測：鑽心取樣測強度與氯離子、保護層與鋼筋腐蝕調查、基礎與沖刷評估，並以新反力重新計算；若下部結構需補強，補強應在封閉前完成並驗收，避免在封閉期間處理未知問題。~Before design, complete a detailed substructure survey: cores for strength and chloride, cover and corrosion surveys, and foundation and scour assessment, then recalculate with the new reactions; any substructure strengthening must be finished and accepted before the closure rather than dealing with unknowns during it.
units.failure: 只檢查支承座外觀就沿用舊橋台，新橋反力使老化的台帽在支承下方開裂；舊伸縮縫位置沒有改善排水，數年後台帽與支承仍持續劣化，新上部結構的壽命被舊下部結構拖累。~Reusing an old abutment after only a visual check of the seats lets the heavier new reactions crack the aged cap under the bearings; leaving drainage at the old joint unimproved means cap and bearings keep deteriorating, so the old substructure limits the life of the new superstructure.
units.misconception: SPMT 換橋只是換上部結構，下部結構可以照舊不必評估。~An SPMT replacement only swaps the superstructure, so the substructure needs no assessment.
units.practice: 業主在規劃階段就應決定下部結構的保留、補強或新建策略，並把檢測結果與承載評估納入招標文件；新舊介面的防水與排水細部由設計單位統一負責。~The owner should decide at planning stage whether to keep, strengthen or rebuild the substructure and include the survey results and capacity assessment in the tender; the designer takes single responsibility for waterproofing and drainage details at new-to-old interfaces.

units.anchor: 用路人成本與交接紀錄~User cost and handover records
units.title: 成效評估、紀錄與交接~Benefit evaluation, records and handover
units.mechanism: SPMT 換橋的設備與預製成本通常較高，其合理性來自用路人延滯、繞道與施工區安全風險的大幅降低，所以工程結束後應以實際封閉時間、交通量與事故紀錄評估成效，作為下一個專案的決策依據。交接時除了新橋的竣工資料，還要保存運輸階段計算、監測資料、地盤試驗與落梁紀錄，因為新橋曾經歷一次與設計不同的受力狀態，日後若在梁端發現裂縫，這些資料是判斷成因的關鍵。~SPMT replacements usually cost more in equipment and prefabrication; their justification lies in large reductions in user delay, detours and work-zone safety risk, so after completion the actual closure time, traffic volumes and incident records should be used to evaluate the benefit and inform the next project's decision. Handover should keep not only the new bridge's as-built data but also the transport-stage calculations, monitoring data, ground tests and set-down records, because the span once experienced a load state different from its design, and these data are key to explaining any cracking found later at the girder ends.
units.model: 用路人延滯成本 = 交通量 × 每車延滯時間 × 時間價值。每日 40,000 輛、每車繞道多 10 分鐘、每車小時價值 20 元：每日 40,000×(10/60)×20 ≈ 133,000 元；傳統分階段施工影響 180 天約 2,400 萬元，SPMT 週末封閉 2 天約 27 萬元。數值為教學假設。~User delay cost = traffic × delay per vehicle × value of time. With 40,000 vehicles a day, 10 minutes of extra detour each and a value of 20 currency units per vehicle-hour, the daily cost is 40,000×(10/60)×20 ≈ 133,000; 180 days of staged construction cost about 24 million, while a 2-day SPMT weekend closure costs about 270,000. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以封閉前後的交通偵測資料計算實際延滯與繞道量，與規劃階段的預估比較；交接文件清單逐項核對，包括運輸計算、監測原始資料、平鈑試驗、落梁量測、支承與伸縮縫安裝紀錄，由業主驗收簽認。~Use traffic detector data from before, during and after the closure to compute actual delay and detour volumes and compare with planning estimates; check the handover list item by item, including transport calculations, raw monitoring data, plate tests, set-down measurements and bearing and joint installation records, accepted and signed by the owner.
units.failure: 沒有保存運輸階段資料，數年後檢查發現梁端頂緣裂縫，無法判斷是運輸時造成還是營運中產生，只能以保守方式補強；缺乏成效評估則讓下一個專案無法合理比較工法。~Without transport-stage records, cracks found years later at girder-end tops cannot be attributed to the move or to service, so they are strengthened conservatively; without benefit evaluation the next project cannot compare methods rationally.
units.misconception: 新橋就位、恢復通車之後，運輸階段的資料就沒有保存價值。~Once the new span is set and traffic resumes, transport-stage data are no longer worth keeping.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含竣工圖、運輸與暫置計算、監測與試驗資料、落梁與支承紀錄、封閉時段實際時程與用路人成本評估；首次定期檢查特別檢視梁端與支承座。~Handover documents should include as-built drawings, transport and storage calculations, monitoring and test data, set-down and bearing records, the actual closure timeline and user-cost evaluation; the first routine inspection should look closely at girder ends and bearing seats.

example: 設計練習：一跨 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m）的預力梁橋，以 SPMT 運輸，比較運輸支點內縮距離 a。a = 3.0 m：跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m，梁端負彎矩含 15% 動態放大 1.15×250×3²/2 ≈ 1,294 kN·m；a = 4.5 m：跨中 250×31²/8 − 250×4.5²/2 = 27,500 kN·m，梁端 1.15×250×4.5²/2 ≈ 2,911 kN·m；a = 6.0 m：跨中 20,000 kN·m，梁端 ≈ 5,175 kN·m。若梁端頂緣容許的附加負彎矩上限為 3,000 kN·m，則 a ≤ √[2×3,000/(1.15×250)] ≈ 4.57 m，取 a = 4.5 m 以內。軸線數量以 (10,000 + 1,000)×1.15/235 ≈ 54 軸線、利用率 80% 時約 68 軸線計，選 72 軸線。若橋重因加裝護欄增加 5%，所需軸線變為 54×1.05/0.8 ≈ 71，仍在 72 軸線內但餘裕幾乎用盡。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: a 40 m prestressed span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) is moved by SPMT, comparing the support inset a. For a = 3.0 m, midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m and the end hogging moment with 15% dynamic allowance is 1.15×250×3²/2 ≈ 1,294 kN·m; for a = 4.5 m, midspan 250×31²/8 − 250×4.5²/2 = 27,500 kN·m and end 1.15×250×4.5²/2 ≈ 2,911 kN·m; for a = 6.0 m, midspan 20,000 kN·m and end about 5,175 kN·m. If the girder-end top fibre can accept at most 3,000 kN·m of added hogging, a ≤ √[2×3,000/(1.15×250)] ≈ 4.57 m, so a is kept within 4.5 m. Axle lines: (10,000 + 1,000)×1.15/235 ≈ 54, about 68 at 80% utilisation, so 72 are chosen. If barriers add 5% to the weight, the need becomes 54×1.05/0.8 ≈ 71, still within 72 but with almost no margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 自行式模組運輸車原用於造船、石化與重型設備搬運，歐洲較早普遍以它把整座預製橋梁在數分鐘至數小時內開到橋位。美國 FHWA 的國際考察團隊在 2004 年前後參訪歐洲案例，2007 年出版 SPMT 移除與更換橋梁手冊，收錄荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 兩跨橋（逾 3,600 噸、134 軸線、移動 2 小時）、法國 PRA 13 09 鐵路橋（48 小時封閉）、芝加哥 Wells Street 2002 年週末換橋，以及 2006 年佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue 換橋的詳細案例。2011 年 FHWA 加速橋梁施工手冊把 SPMT 與橫移、豎軸旋轉並列為重型移動工法，使其成為加速橋梁施工的標準選項之一。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Self-propelled modular transporters were first used in shipbuilding, petrochemicals and heavy-equipment haulage, and Europe was early to use them routinely to drive whole prefabricated bridges to site in minutes to hours. An FHWA international scan team visited European cases around 2004, and in 2007 FHWA published its manual on using SPMTs to remove and replace bridges, documenting the Netherlands' two-span Badhoevedorp A4/A5 bridge (more than 3,600 tons, 134 axle lines, a 2-hour move), France's PRA 13 09 railway bridge (a 48-hour closure), Chicago's Wells Street weekend replacement in 2002 and Florida's 2006 I-4/Graves Avenue replacement in detail. FHWA's 2011 Accelerated Bridge Construction manual placed SPMTs alongside lateral slides and vertical-axis pivots as heavy-movement methods, making them a standard ABC option. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: FHWA 手冊：SPMT 每軸線最大承載約 26 至 33 美噸（24 至 30 公噸），依車寬而定~FHWA manual: an SPMT axle line carries a maximum of about 26 to 33 US tons (24 to 30 t), depending on width
每軸線最大接地壓力約每平方英尺 1,500 至 2,000 磅~Each axle line exerts a maximum ground pressure of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot
載重行駛速度通常約 3 mph（4.8 km/h），可應付約 18 吋地面起伏與約 8% 坡度~Loaded SPMTs typically travel at about 3 mph (4.8 km/h) and handle about 18 inch surface variations and about 8% grades
可用液壓行程至少約 24 吋，作業宜假設 16 至 20 吋；動態放大至少 15% 自重~Available hydraulic stroke is at least about 24 inches, with 16 to 20 inches assumed in operations; dynamic allowance is at least 15% of dead load

佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue（2006）新跨約 143 ft（43.5 m）、約 1,300 美噸，運到橋位約 30 分鐘~Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue (2006) new spans were about 143 ft (43.5 m) and about 1,300 US tons, each driven to site in about 30 minutes
荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 兩跨橋長約 390 ft（118.8 m）、逾 3,600 美噸，以 134 軸線移動 2 小時~The Badhoevedorp A4/A5 two-span bridge, about 390 ft (118.8 m) and over 3,600 US tons, moved on 134 axle lines in 2 hours
芝加哥 Wells Street 2002 年以 SPMT 在一個週末換上 111 ft、425 美噸的鋼桁架~Chicago's Wells Street bridge received a 111 ft, 425 US ton steel truss by SPMT over one weekend in 2002
法國 PRA 13 09 鐵路橋以約每分鐘 8 吋移動 146 ft，鐵路只封閉 48 小時~France's PRA 13 09 railway bridge moved 146 ft at about 8 inches per minute with a rail closure of only 48 hours
